title: A lamp on hold

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: The shop’s holding run 42 because it’s on the return slip. Verify the run before six. After six, only the morning desk can change that field.
turns.zh: 退貨單寫的是第 42 批，所以店家暫時扣留了這批貨。請在六點前核對批次；六點以後只有早班櫃檯能改那個欄位。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: That slip uses the number on the box. The shop reuses boxes. Our factory sheet puts the lamp socket on the left for 39, middle for 41, right for 42, looking at the handle side.
turns.zh: 退貨單抄的是外箱號碼。店家會重複使用箱子。工廠單是從有提把那面看：燈的插座第 39 批在左，第 41 批在中間，第 42 批在右。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: The lamp’s upright in the photo, with the handle facing away. On the left in the photo is the socket, just below a round sticker marked 41. Those stickers identify the inspector.
turns.zh: 照片裡燈具是直立的，提把朝另一邊。插座在照片左邊、寫著 41 的圓貼紙正下方。那種貼紙是用來辨識檢查人員的。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: The shop cord cuts out on both lamps if I jiggle the plug. Our bench lamp already had a loose socket. With our cord both lit up, but I didn’t move the plug.
turns.zh: 店家的線接到任一盞燈上，只要我搖插頭就會斷電。工作台那盞燈的插座本來就鬆。接我們的線時兩盞都會亮，不過我沒有動插頭。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Don’t tell the stockroom the hold is lifted until we check the lamp in person. The intake chat is just for us.
turns.zh: 要現場查過燈才能通知庫房解除扣留。收件聊天室只有我們會看到。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: The courier just took the lamp. I can use the photo for our record, but the lamp won’t be back till tomorrow. It’s five to six.
turns.zh: 快遞剛把燈拿走。我可以用照片處理內部紀錄，但燈明天才會送回來。現在差五分鐘六點。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: For the cord test, remember the shop got a steady light until a customer brushed the plug. We have another lamp here with a tight socket.
turns.zh: 測電線時別忘了，店家的燈原本一直亮著，直到有顧客擦碰到插頭。這裡另有一盞燈，插座很緊實。
